content.text:
Output ONLY one fresh 2-4 word lowercase phrase for macOS say. It must describe the completed coding work. It must not exactly match any recent phrase. No punctuation, no quotes, no preamble.
Recent used phrases, avoid exactly:
name case fixed
mobile stone story verified
stone grounding fallback added
stone copy tightened
contact sheets delivered
journey screens shipped
stone stories shipped
journey commits pushed
stone story commits landed
sonar motion issue flagged
in flight requests cancelled
start over race fixed
story endpoint trust gap
branch synced with main
regression tests added
headstone dates cited correctly
story dates cited
codex feedback addressed
search progress announced
push hooks passed
codex fixes pushed
stone dates sourced
story tabs e2e passing
hero avif fallback added
fog lantern layering fixed

Closing message:
* scan sweep, progress dots.
  - **Story:** text reveal.
- On phones the fog and glow still appear, just without moving.
- Checked in Chrome: 3 animations run at 1440×900, and none run on an emulated phone.
- `src/app.css`: removed the global `!important` reduced-motion rule, which clears both Sonar issues.

**Load-time testing: LHCI can't be used here**
- The repo rules ban `@lhci/cli` and every form of `lighthouse` (its dependencies carry unpatched advisories), and your global rules ban LHCI in CI.
- The Lighthouse-based alternatives the search turned up (Unlighthouse, `playwright-lighthouse`) pull in the same package.
- I picked Google's own `web-vitals` library, run inside the existing Playwright suite: it has no dependencies, measures vitals the way Chrome does, and runs in CI with no workflow changes.
- **New `src/routes/load.e2e.ts`:** loads the invitation at phone size on a throttled slow mobile network with 4× CPU slowdown.
  - **Budgets:** Google's "good" thresholds. First paint (FCP) ≤ 1800 ms, largest paint (LCP) ≤ 2500 ms, layout shift (CLS) ≤ 0.1.
  - **Current result:** FCP 640 ms, LCP 640 ms, CLS 0.0009.
  - **Proof it can fail:** with 1500 ms of network latency it failed on FCP at 4632 ms.
- `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`: added `web-vitals` 6.2.3, pinned exactly, released 2026-10-05.

**Checks**
- `make ai-checks` passes (213 unit tests, no warnings), and all 26 e2e tests pass.

**Also waiting to commit:** the story tabs, the favicon set, and the AVIF/WebP hero.

Sources:
- [Core Web Vitals testing in Playwright with PerformanceObserver (2026)](https://qaskills.sh/blog/core-web-vitals-testing-guide-2026)
- [Unlighthouse: Lighthouse with Playwright](https://unlighthouse.dev/learn-lighthouse/playwright)
- [sitespeed.io CI docs](https://www.sitespeed.io/documentation/sitespeed.io/continuous-integration/)
- [Snyk: @lhci/cli](https://security.snyk.io/package/npm/%40lhci%2Fcli)
- [Core Web Vitals thresholds](https://web.dev/articles/vitals)
